key.name: enabled-effects
key.description: List of animated pattern IDs active on the desktop wallpaper.

key.name: background-mode
key.description: Base layer underneath patterns: 'desktop' (system wallpaper overlay), 'color' (palette gradient), or 'image' (custom picture).

key.name: color-palette
key.description: Color scheme used when background-mode is 'color'.

key.name: custom-image
key.description: Path to custom wallpaper image used when background-mode is 'image'.

key.name: target-fps
key.description: Target FPS for animation loop (30 or 60).

key.name: speed
key.description: Pace multiplier for all animations (0.25 to 3.0).

key.name: opacity
key.description: Global opacity of the animated patterns (0.1 to 1.0).

key.name: pause-on-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause when fullscreen window is active
key.description: Stops drawing while a fullscreen window is visible to save GPU and CPU power.

key.name: pause-on-battery
key.description: Stops or reduces animations when the device is running on battery.
